title: Your Daily 3 € Snack, Invested Instead 💶 #shorts
description:
Guess: what does 3 € a day become in 20 years? Comment a number.

3 € a day is about 91 € a month. Paid in over 20 years: 21,900 €. At an assumed ~6 % a year (Finanztip planning value for broad world stock ETFs, monthly compounding, before tax and inflation) it could be about 42,200 €. Keep going 10 more years: 32,850 € paid in, about 91,700 € — the last 10 years add more than the first 20. Returns are not guaranteed; values go up and down, and the past is no promise.

Sources: Finanztip (6 % planning return for stock ETFs); maths: monthly compounding

Not financial advice.
